title: Git: long branch names and a push option
support_note: A push no grant or working-set entry covers whole files one request for the whole push: internal/gitbroker/approval.go askForPush, which builds the About with pushAbout and the request with pushRequest (approvalauthority.go). The headline counts refs and never names them (pushAbout); the long names reach a notifier only through refs and description.
story: An agent pushes two branches with very long names and a push option the server acts on, to exercise how a notifier truncates.
